title: Hellrider's Pride

sources.title: Helm's Protection
markers: | description = When you heal another creature, it gains [[Resistance]] to {{DamageType|Bludgeoning}}, {{DamageType|Piercing}}, and {{DamageType|Slashing}} damage dealt by weapon attacks {{see bugs}} for 2 turns.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves. When you heal another creature, give it Blade Ward for 2 turns.

fields.Helm’s Protection: Grants resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from any source, despite the weapon-only tooltip. Does not extend existing Blade Ward and does not apply to the wearer.
fields.Base value: 110 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Equipment interactions: These gloves are not classed as armour, so Mage Armour and Unarmoured Defence can still apply.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
